description.value: Supreme Pizza is a neighbourhood pizzeria on Victoria Drive in East Vancouver offering handcrafted classic and specialty pizzas alongside pasta, chicken wings, and salads. The menu includes a dedicated Veggie Pizza and multiple specialty pies, with ordering available direct, through Skip the Dishes, Uber Eats, and DoorDash. It is a pickup and delivery-focused operation serving the residential neighbourhood.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the business is an active pizza restaurant at 6539 Victoria Drive, Vancouver, with pickup and delivery. The website confirms the OSM phone number (604-324-2515) and address. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, or washrooms anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; vegetarian options are explicitly mentioned ('Veggie Pizza, made with a delicious blend of fresh vegetables'); takeout/pickup is confirmed via the website's 'Pickup' option and ordering page.
concerns: None of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking or visibility, water bottle refill, washrooms) are evidenced on the website or in OSM tags.
Business hours begin at 4:00 pm daily, making it unavailable for most daytime cycling tours.
OSM lists only one phone number (+1-604-324-2515); website lists three numbers — (604) 324-2515, (604) 324-1808, (604) 327-1295 — suggesting the OSM record is incomplete.
